components.description: Up to six weeks of paid parental leave at regular base pay for a benefits-eligible faculty member caring for a newborn, newly adopted or pre-adoption foster child, taken in one block within twelve months of the birth or adoption.

components.return_obligation: return to employment at CSM for at least six weeks after the leave, or repay salary plus employer-provided benefits received during the paid leave

notes: Governing document: 2018_03 (Faculty Handbook Section 5, May 2017 revision), accepted as in force on 2018-02-22 by inference; every component citing it carries the version_uncertain flag from the document's version note. 2018_00_link is the 5/20/14 version of the same section, superseded by 2018_03 (its version note); no component is coded from it.

Differences of the superseded 2014 text (2018_00_link), not coded: parental leave required one year of continuous benefits-eligible employment and primary-caregiver status; paid parental leave with sick and medical disability leave was capped at three months per birth or adoption; parental leave after a birth was 'in addition to and taken immediately following' medical disability leave; teaching relief was on request with 'full salary'; the entire parental leave, paid and unpaid, was not to exceed twelve months absent extraordinary circumstances. None of these appear in the 2017 revision.
Section 8 (2018_02, May 2017 revision) supplies the tenure clock (8.1.1 C); the rest of the section is tenure and promotion procedure with no parental provision.
Whom the figures describe (U8): a benefits-eligible tenure-stream member with two years' service; meets the handbook FML's one year and FMLA's 12 months and 1,250 hours.

Chain, birth parent: medical disability leave up to 6 weeks (discretionary; its pay c7 within it) -> paid parental leave up to 6 weeks (also_available, after it) -> unpaid parental leave of negotiated length (consecutive_after c1); teaching relief for the entire semester containing them (c6 within c2, R3b); handbook Family Medical Leave 520 hours (13 weeks) from the start of medical disability leave, federal FMLA alongside it.

Chain, non-birth parent: paid parental leave up to 6 weeks within the semester of teaching relief (R3b) -> unpaid parental leave of negotiated length; handbook Family Medical Leave 520 hours and FMLA from the start of the paid parental leave.

5.4.12(6) caps the aggregate of sick leave and medical disability leave at three months; a cap on two named benefits only, flagged on c6, c7, c8 (checklist §3), not cap_weeks_all_sources and not a leave_limits entry.
Teaching relief (c2): the 2017 text states no pay level for the relief semester (the 2014 'full salary' sentence was removed); flagged R3.

Cross-references not saved: CSM Sabbatical Leave Policy (Handbook subsection 10.2); plan documents and certificates of insurance (LTD and other insurance); Human Resources Office description of family medical leave; Handbook Section 4 (4.2-4.5) and Section 9.1.1; Unlawful Discrimination Policy and Complaint Procedure; Academic Procedures Manual. None appears to set parental leave beyond what Section 5 states, except possibly the plan documents and the HR family-medical-leave rules.
Not components: sabbatical (5.4.1), holiday (5.4.6), funeral (5.4.8), jury (5.4.9), military (5.4.10) and injury (5.4.11) leaves: a parent cannot use them for a birth or adoption.
